name: custom-bridge
description: Connect Kettu Bots to any self-hosted HTTP or WebSocket gateway such as internal chat tools, DingTalk, WeCom, Discord, Matrix, or custom scripts.

description.en: Connect Kettu Bots to your own HTTP or WebSocket gateway using a simple JSON protocol.
description.zh-CN: 通过简洁的 JSON 协议，把 Kettu Bots 接入你自建的 HTTP 或 WebSocket 网关。

settings.title: Bridge endpoint URL
settings.description: Base URL of your self-hosted bridge (for example http://127.0.0.1:8787 or https://bot.internal).

settings.title: Bearer token (optional)
settings.description: Optional bearer token sent in the Authorization header. Stored in the system key store.

settings.title: Transport mode
settings.description: Receive inbound messages over WebSocket push or HTTP long polling.

description.en: Connect Bots to any self-hosted HTTP or WebSocket gateway (internal IM, DingTalk, WeCom, Discord, Matrix, or scripts).
description.zh-CN: 将 Bot 接入任意自建 HTTP 或 WebSocket 网关（企业内网 IM、钉钉、企业微信、Discord、Matrix 等）。
